scope_basis.framework_boundary: The catalogue is a VCL category seed, not proof that an arbitrary Delphi executable is VCL, that a T-prefixed class is a safe native alias, or that FireMonkey is HWND-rendered. Exact component availability varies by Delphi release.

frozen_vcl_ui_family_seed.completion_predicate: Each unit must eventually be independently classified as a bounded public receiver, native preservation, nonvisual/no-style meaning, or a missing real owner/protocol with a named receiver. No group-level compatibility claim is permitted. The official category index also names BDE/dbExpress/Ribbon/Internet/Taskbar families; they remain version/package-dependent catalogue branches and must be added as exact units only after a real Delphi-version/package baseline is selected.
